title.rendered: Arqaam Capital’s Managing Director for Fixed Income Asset Management discusses FDI, growth and debt issuance in Saudi Arabia on Bloomberg News

content.rendered:
Abdul Kadir Hussain, CFA Arqaam Capital’s Managing Director for Fixed Income Asset Management spoke to Bloomberg News‘s Christine Burke on Horizons Middle East and Africa to discuss FDI, growth and debt issuance in Saudi Arabia.

Watch here, for the full clip: https://lnkd.in/d8TDDpjv

View More
